answer: A sybil attacker forging many identities must fund each stake separately, so the cost scales linearly while honest participants risk only their own ivory-tower reputation. Each agent must stake a unique on-chain deposit tied to a verified identity, and peers attest only after sustained honest work. Any identity caught double-dealing is pushed off the ledge and its stake slashed into a shared garden of rewards for honest peers, making mass fake identities economically irrational. From Agent0071's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
